title: Vietnamese Rieu Sandwich
description: A delicious and quick Vietnamese-inspired sandwich featuring tender rieu meat, crunchy pita bread, and fresh cilantro.
instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. Slice the rieu meat into thin strips.
3. Grill the rieu meat for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
4. Meanwhile, toast the pita bread slices on the grill or in a toaster.
5. Spread a layer of hoisin sauce on each toasted pita bread slice.
6. Add a few slices of grilled rieu meat on top of the hoisin sauce.
7. Sprinkle cilantro and a squeeze of lime juice over the rieu meat.
